home.heroBody: 369AI builds intelligent Point-of-Sale, ERP and automation systems that help retail, food service and hospitality businesses operate smarter, faster and more efficiently.
home.aboutTitle: Technology that drives efficiency, accuracy and growth

Established with a mission to simplify operations and enhance customer experiences, we deliver modern, scalable and industry-specific POS systems tailored for retail, food service and hospitality sectors.
home.aboutBody2: Our expertise extends beyond POS — offering smart integrations, advanced analytics and seamless connectivity to help businesses make informed decisions in real time. With a strong presence in Oman and beyond, we pride ourselves on delivering unmatched reliability, personalized service and 24/7 technical support.
home.pillarsBody: Every part of the 369AI stack talks to every other part — so your counter, your warehouse and your back office all see the same numbers.

services.title: POS, IoT and automation services
services.body: From the counter to the cloud, we cover the whole stack — and we stay with you after go-live.

iot.title: IoT-Enabled Vending & Smart Devices
iot.lead: Manage your vending machines and smart devices remotely through cloud-based monitoring and automation.
iot.body: With a single, intuitive platform, you gain real-time visibility into performance, inventory and energy usage — no matter where you are. Automated alerts and intelligent controls help reduce downtime, cut costs and streamline operations, while remote access ensures you are always in command.

pos.title: Smart POS & Retail Systems
pos.lead: Transform your business efficiency with intelligent POS solutions that unify billing, inventory and customer management.
pos.body: Go beyond transactions with advanced analytics, automated reporting and integrated loyalty programs that empower your teams, delight your customers and maximize profitability. Whether you are managing a single store or scaling across multiple locations, our cloud-driven platform ensures agility, transparency and control.

erp.title: ERP Integration for POS & Devices
erp.lead: Unify every department — sales, accounts, HR and inventory — under one powerful ERP platform.
erp.body: By bringing all your core business functions together in a single, integrated system, you eliminate silos and ensure seamless collaboration across teams. Real-time data sharing empowers smarter decision-making, while automated workflows reduce manual effort and errors.

ai.title: AI-Driven Insights & Automation
ai.lead: Leverage artificial intelligence to analyze data, predict trends and automate decision-making.
ai.body: With AI-driven insights, your organization can transform raw information into actionable strategies, uncover hidden patterns and anticipate market shifts before they happen. Predictive analytics empower smarter planning, while automation streamlines repetitive tasks and reduces human error.

cloud.title: Secure Cloud Infrastructure
cloud.lead: Access your systems anywhere with enterprise-grade security and reliable cloud performance.
cloud.body: Empower your workforce with the freedom to connect from any location, while sensitive data remains protected by advanced encryption and compliance standards. With enterprise-grade safeguards, your operations stay secure against evolving threats, and performance stays consistent even during peak demand.

support.title: Professional Support & Maintenance
support.lead: Enjoy dedicated after-sales service and 24/7 technical support to keep your systems running smoothly.
support.body: Our commitment does not end at installation — we stand by you with continuous assistance, ensuring your operations remain efficient and uninterrupted. With round-the-clock technical support, expert guidance is always a call or click away, minimizing downtime and resolving issues before they impact performance.

services.ctaBody: A dedicated after-sales team, free remote management and a 12-month warranty as standard.

solutions.title: Empowering Businesses Through Smart Innovation
solutions.body: At 369AI we combine intelligence, automation and connectivity to revolutionize the way businesses operate. Our suite of solutions — ERP, Smart Locks, Robotics, POS and Vending Machines — delivers seamless integration between hardware and software. From real-time insights to automated operations, we help companies enhance efficiency, improve security and create smarter customer experiences.

erp.title: ERP Solutions
erp.body: Reimagine the way your business operates with our intelligent ERP platform — built to unify every department and process under one digital ecosystem. From accounting, HR and inventory to CRM and sales, our ERP gives you real-time visibility and complete control. Powered by automation and AI insights, it simplifies operations, improves decision-making and helps you grow faster with accuracy and confidence.

pos.title: 369AI POS Solutions
pos.body: Meet the future of retail and service management with our next-generation 369AI POS System. Designed for speed, simplicity and accuracy, it connects directly with your ERP for real-time sales, inventory and accounting updates. Whether you are managing a single counter or a multi-branch business, enjoy seamless billing, barcode scanning, multi-payment options and cloud-based reporting — all in one modern interface.

robotics.title: Robotics & Automation
robotics.body: Unlock new levels of efficiency with our AI-powered robotic and automation solutions. From product dispensing and warehouse management to smart manufacturing and vending automation, our robots integrate with ERP and IoT systems to deliver precision, consistency and real-time coordination. By reducing human error and repetitive tasks, we help businesses operate smarter and faster than ever before.

locks.title: Smart Lock Systems
locks.body: Redefine security with our IoT-based Smart Locks designed for modern businesses. Integrated with ERP and mobile apps, these locks provide centralized access control, live monitoring and digital authorization for users and locations. Perfect for warehouses, offices and vending systems — ensuring every access is secure, recorded and controlled in real time.

vending.title: Smart Vending Machine Solutions
vending.body: Experience the future of unmanned retail through our Smart Vending Machines powered by AI, IoT and ERP integration. Manage products, track stock and monitor performance remotely — all while offering customers an effortless buying experience through touchless, card or QR-based payments. Designed for efficiency and 24/7 operation, it is the perfect blend of innovation, convenience and business intelligence.

about.title: Explore how 369AI transforms innovation into intelligent business automation
about.intro: 369AI is a forward-thinking technology company dedicated to delivering intelligent, scalable and future-ready software solutions that empower businesses to operate smarter, faster and more efficiently. We specialize in AI-driven automation, ERP implementation, custom software development and advanced business intelligence tools designed to transform organizations into modern digital enterprises.
about.intro2: Our mission is simple: to simplify complex business operations through innovative technology and intelligent automation. We combine deep industry knowledge with cutting-edge AI capabilities to build solutions that not only solve today's challenges but also prepare businesses for tomorrow's opportunities.
about.intro3: We are also a trusted provider of ERP solutions, offering end-to-end implementation, customization, integration and support services. From finance and sales to inventory, manufacturing, POS, HR and custom business applications, we help companies streamline processes and achieve operational excellence.

innovation.title: Innovation First
innovation.body: We continuously explore new technologies, AI models and automation trends to ensure our clients stay ahead in a competitive market.

client.title: Client-Centric Approach
client.body: Every solution is tailored to meet the unique requirements of each business, ensuring maximum efficiency and value.

quality.title: Quality & Reliability
quality.body: Our solutions are designed for performance, security and long-term scalability.

support.title: Continuous Support
support.body: We provide ongoing support, maintenance and training to help our clients get the most out of their digital systems.

about.missionBody: At 369AI we take pride in our unwavering commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction. With a team of passionate and skilled professionals, we are dedicated to providing top-tier assistance across computer sales, printer servicing, CCTV installation, computer networking and data recovery.
about.visionBody: 369AI envisions becoming a global leader in advanced technological solutions, shaping a future where technology enhances every aspect of life. Through continuous innovation and adaptation, we strive to pioneer the digital landscape, exceed customer expectations and foster a culture of improvement. With a strong global presence, we aim to be a trusted symbol of reliability, driving societal progress and positive impact.

products.title: Streamline your operations with 369AI's ERP modules
products.body: From sales to service — comprehensive modules to manage your entire business.
products.posBody: Everything you need to run your business efficiently, all in one system.
products.howBody: Get started in four easy steps.

posScale.b: The weight goes straight into the bill with no manual typing, and the customer-facing display shows what is being weighed and what it costs as it happens.

toolsRental.b: Every tool that goes out and comes back, with rental periods, customer details, timesheets and automatic cost calculation.

mobileRepair.b: Job intake through to delivery: device and fault details, spare parts, technician assignment, repair status and invoicing.

posInvoice.b: Branded, editable POS invoices — logo, company details, tax lines and footer — configured from the back office rather than in code.

posLoyalty.b: Points earned and redeemed at the counter, with the customer's balance and available rewards in front of the cashier during checkout.

kraKpi.b: Set role objectives and score them on a purpose-built board, with results rolling up from the individual to the department.

privilege.b: Control what each user sees and does, field by field — hide menus, lock fields, and grant create, read, write and delete per person rather than per group.

attendance.b: Late tracking with automatic deductions, leave and work-from-home requests, device management and reports, in one place.

showroom.b: Scheduled photo checks that a showroom still matches its agreed layout, with the evidence stored against every visit.

signage.b: Full-screen promotional signage on in-store displays, doubling as a barcode price checker customers can use themselves.

pharmacy.b: A pharmacy counter with batch and expiry tracking, so short-dated stock is caught before it reaches a customer.

credit.b: Customer credit limits with an approval step, so an order beyond the limit stops and waits for a decision instead of shipping.

intercompany.b: Move stock and its value between companies with a request and approval flow, keeping both sets of books straight.

offlineSync.b: Keep billing when the connection drops — the counter switches to local data and syncs back afterwards, with a cross-check so nothing is duplicated or lost.

vehicleTracking.b: Trips, driver logs and vehicle movement in one place, with automatic checks that flag journeys which do not add up.

f1.b: Fast, intuitive touchscreen billing for smooth transactions.

f2.b: Automatically updates stock after every sale to keep your inventory accurate.

f3.b: Track daily, weekly and monthly performance with actionable insights.

f4.b: Accept cash, card, UPI and digital wallets seamlessly.

f5.b: Manage your store anytime, anywhere with secure cloud connectivity.

f6.b: Keep track of loyalty points, purchase history and customer profiles.

s1.b: Add store details, taxes and payment options.

s2.b: Enter products, prices and stock levels.

s3.b: Quickly process sales using the touchscreen interface.

s4.b: Track sales, trends and customer insights.

a2.b: Installable .exe applications for billing counters and back-office machines, built for speed on local hardware.

a3.b: Keep selling through a dropped connection; everything syncs back to the ERP once you are online again.

appsPage.title: Ten apps. One connected back office.
appsPage.body: Every 369AI mobile app talks straight to Odoo — attendance, chat, sales, rentals and store operations all feed the same core your business already runs on. Built in-house, deployed on your own server, supported 24/7.
appsPage.mobileBody: Purpose-built Android apps for the people who do not sit at a desk — each one signs into your Odoo server and works with live company data.
appsPage.desktopBody: Installable Windows .exe applications for billing counters and back-office machines, built for speed on local hardware.
appsPage.desktopF1: Runs natively on the counter PC — fast even on modest hardware.
appsPage.desktopF2: Keeps working through a dropped connection and syncs back to the ERP once you are online again.
appsPage.desktopF3: Installed and updated by our team, with 24/7 support behind it.
appsPage.detailBody: A closer look at the ten apps — what each one is for and what it handles day to day.

alphalize.tagline: The whole Odoo back office in one app.
alphalize.f1: Around forty Odoo workflows — sales, purchase, inventory, payments and approvals — behind a single home screen.
alphalize.f2: Raise orders and estimates and print the invoice straight from the phone.
alphalize.f3: Driver trips are tracked and turned into field attendance automatically.

attendance.tagline: Check in and out, and apply for leave from the phone.
attendance.f1: One-tap check-in and check-out against your Odoo server.
attendance.f2: A month view that takes shape as you work.
attendance.f3: Leave requests raised and tracked in the same app.

chats.tagline: A company messenger built on Odoo.
chats.f1: Threads, groups, media, polls and reactions — all held on your own server.
chats.f2: Identity tied to a phone number rather than an email address.
chats.f3: Voice notes and calls signalled through the same Odoo backend.

kraKpi.tagline: Workday and task tracking against KRA/KPI targets.
kraKpi.f1: Staff run their day against the targets assigned to them.
kraKpi.f2: Admins configure targets and assign work from the same app.
kraKpi.f3: Clients file requirements and settle invoices in one place.

showroomCheck.tagline: Scheduled proof that a showroom matches its agreed layout.
showroomCheck.f1: Admins define how many rounds happen per day and the window for each.
showroomCheck.f2: Staff are guided through a directional sweep of the room, photo by photo.
showroomCheck.f3: The server compares each photo against the reference — a missed round is visible.

priceChecker.tagline: Signage that becomes a price checker the moment a barcode is scanned.
priceChecker.f1: Banners scroll on the screen until someone scans a product.
priceChecker.f2: Runs on a tablet using its camera, or a POS terminal with a USB scanner.
priceChecker.f3: One build covers both kinds of hardware.

restaurant.tagline: A restaurant POS on Odoo — tables, orders and kitchen tickets.
restaurant.f1: Open a table, build the order from the category grid, fire the kitchen ticket.
restaurant.f2: Prints to real network printers without an agent on the till.
restaurant.f3: Works in English and Arabic, including right-to-left layout.

spa.tagline: A walk-in kiosk for reception, running unattended on a tablet.
spa.f1: The customer picks a service and answers only the questions it requires.
spa.f2: The disclaimer is signed on the tablet itself.
spa.f3: The booking lands in Odoo for the receptionist to approve.

toolManagement.tagline: Rent tools and equipment out and back in from a phone.
toolManagement.f1: Pricing by hour, day, week or month.
toolManagement.f2: Check-out and check-in with a running timesheet.
toolManagement.f3: The rental cost is worked out for you.

vanSale.tagline: A van-sales POS — sell off the vehicle and keep the books straight.
vanSale.f1: Pick products, take payment and print a receipt with your own layout.
vanSale.f2: Buy stock back in from the same app.
vanSale.f3: Every order carries the GPS location it was raised at.

c2.title: Cashierless machine

c3.title: Inventory management

general.title: General
general.q1: Which industries do you build for?
general.a1: Retail, food service and hospitality are our core sectors, alongside warehousing, banking self-service and unmanned retail. If you run a counter, a stockroom or a fleet of machines, we have deployed something close to your setup.
general.q2: Do you supply hardware, software, or both?
general.a2: Both, and they are designed to work together. You can take the full 369AI stack — POS terminals, printers, scanners and ERP — or just the hardware, integrated with the system you already run.
general.q3: Can 369AI integrate with our existing ERP or accounting system?
general.a3: Yes. Our POS and device platforms expose standard APIs and we routinely integrate with existing ERP, accounting and payment systems rather than asking you to replace them.
general.q4: What support do you provide after installation?
general.a4: 24/7 technical support, a dedicated after-sales engineering team, and a standard 12-month warranty with extended options. Our free remote management system lets us monitor, update and troubleshoot devices without a site visit.
general.q5: Which countries do you operate in?
general.a5: We have offices in the USA, UAE, Oman (Ruwi, Salalah and Sohar) and India, and we support deployments across the wider region.

apps.title: Mobile Apps
apps.q1: Which platforms do the apps run on?
apps.a1: All ten are built with React Native and ship for Android today — attendance, chat, KRA/KPI, showroom checks, price checking, restaurant POS, spa reception, tool rentals, van sales and the full back office; iOS builds are available on request.
apps.q2: Do the apps need Odoo to work?
apps.a2: Yes — each app signs into your own Odoo server and works with live company data, so sales, stock and attendance land in the same ERP the rest of the business uses.
apps.q3: Can the apps be customized for our workflows?
apps.a3: Yes. We build and maintain them in-house, so screens, fields and approval flows can be adapted to the way your team works.
apps.q4: What happens when the connection drops?
apps.a4: The selling apps keep the sale moving and sync back to the ERP once you are online again; live features such as chat reconnect automatically.
apps.q5: How do we get the apps installed?
apps.a5: They are deployed privately to your devices by our team as part of setup — not through the public app stores — and updates are handled for you.

desktop.title: Desktop Software
desktop.a1: Installable Windows .exe applications for billing counters and back-office machines, built for speed on local hardware.
desktop.a2: Yes — it is offline-first: you keep billing through a dropped connection and everything syncs back to the ERP once you are online again.
desktop.a3: Any recent Windows PC — the software is built to run fast on the modest hardware found at real billing counters.
desktop.a4: Installed and updated by our team, with 24/7 support behind it — you never manage installers yourself.

erp.title: Odoo & ERP
erp.q1: Do you implement Odoo end to end?
erp.a1: Yes — modules, configuration, custom development, training and go-live, run by the same in-house team that builds our apps.
erp.q2: Can we keep our data when moving to Odoo?
erp.a2: Yes. Migration of products, customers, stock and open balances is part of the implementation.
erp.q3: Does Odoo run on our own server or in the cloud?
erp.a3: Either — we deploy on your own server or on a managed cloud instance; your data stays yours in both cases.
erp.a4: The full back office — sales, purchase, inventory, accounting, HR and more; the Software page lists the modules we deploy most.

hardware.title: Hardware & Shop
hardware.a1: Browse the Hardware catalog, add items to your inquiry basket and send it — our team replies with pricing and availability.
hardware.q2: Will the hardware work with the software?
hardware.a2: Yes, that is the point of the range: terminals, printers, scanners and kiosks are chosen and tested to run our POS, ERP and apps.
hardware.a3: Yes — we deliver, install and configure on site, and our support team stays behind the deployment afterwards.
hardware.q4: Is there a warranty on devices?
hardware.a4: A standard 12-month warranty with extended options, plus our free remote management system for monitoring and updates.

pricing.title: Pricing & Plans
pricing.a1: Add the hardware you are interested in to your inquiry basket and send it to us, or contact our sales team directly. We quote per configuration, so pricing reflects what you actually need.
pricing.a2: Configuration — the modules, apps, devices and number of sites you actually need; we quote per configuration rather than a flat tier.
pricing.q3: Can we see it working before we buy?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What we collect through this website, why we collect it, and what you can ask us to do with it.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: This website is operated by 369AI, a brand of Alphalize Technologies, with offices in India, the UAE, Oman and the United States. For the information described here we are the data controller — we decide why it is collected and what happens to it afterwards. You can reach us using the details in the last section.

scope.title: What this policy covers
scope.body: This policy covers this website and the forms on it. It does not cover the systems we build and install for our clients: when we implement Odoo, a POS counter or a mobile app inside another company, that company controls the data held in it and its own privacy policy applies, not ours.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.lead: Very little, and only where you hand it to us on purpose. There is no visitor account on this site and nothing to sign up for.

apps.title: Job applications
apps.body: If you apply for a role, we receive and store what you type into the form together with the CV you upload:
apps.i5: Your CV as a PDF, its original filename, and the date and time you sent it

enquiries.title: Enquiries
enquiries.body: The contact, product and careers enquiry forms send nothing to our servers. They compose a message from what you have typed and open WhatsApp with it ready to go — nothing reaches us until you press send there. This is described further below.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: If you write a review, we store the name you give, the company you name, the product you are reviewing, your rating and your words. Reviews are held out of sight until someone here approves them. Once approved, your review is published on this website under that name, where anyone can read it. Ask us and we will take yours down.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site sets one cookie, and only for our own staff: a signed session cookie for the page where our team edits job listings and contact details. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies of any kind. We do not use Google Analytics, Tag Manager, advertising pixels or session recording.

storage.title: Storage in your browser
storage.body: The site remembers three small things on your own device: that you have seen the opening animation, that you have dismissed the greeting from our assistant, and that you have hidden the promotional message. These stay in your browser, are never sent to us, and clearing your browsing data removes them.

technical.title: Your IP address
technical.body: When you send a form or a review, our server reads the IP address it arrived from so it can limit how often the same source submits and turn away abuse. It is held in memory for that check only — not written to a log, not used to count or profile visitors, and not attached to what you sent.

none.title: What we do not collect
none.body: We do not build visitor profiles, we do not track you across other websites, we do not buy personal data about you, and we never sell or rent anything you give us.

use.title: Why we use it
use.lead: We use what you give us for the reason you gave it, and for nothing else:
use.u1: To reply to your enquiry and to quote for what you asked about
use.u2: To assess your application and to contact you about the role
use.u3: To keep this website working, secure and available
use.u4: To meet our legal and accounting obligations

basis.title: Our lawful basis
basis.body: Under the GDPR we rely on your consent when you send us an application or an enquiry — you choose to fill in the form and press send. We rely on our legitimate interest in operating and securing this website for the staff session cookie. Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 in India, we process your information on the basis of the consent you give when you submit a form.
basis.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time by asking us to delete what you sent. Withdrawing it does not affect anything we did before you asked.

whatsapp.title: How enquiries reach us
whatsapp.body: Our enquiry forms hand off to WhatsApp rather than posting to a server of ours. When you press send in WhatsApp, your message and your phone number are processed by WhatsApp and its parent company, Meta, under their privacy policy rather than this one. If you would prefer not to use WhatsApp, email or telephone us using the details in the last section.

thirdParty.title: Content loaded from other companies
thirdParty.lead: A small part of this site is served by others, and your browser contacts them directly:
thirdParty.t1: YouTube — the preview images on our video rail are served from this site, so Google is not contacted while you are simply reading the page. Pressing play loads the video from youtube-nocookie.com, which is the first time YouTube learns of your visit, and it sets no cookies before that.
thirdParty.t2: Google Maps — our office cards link and QR-code through to Maps. Nothing is embedded in the page, so Google is contacted only if you follow the link.
thirdParty.t3: Fonts are served from our own servers, so no request is made to Google Fonts as you read this.
thirdParty.t4: AI assistants — the footer offers buttons that open ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Perplexity or Mistral with a short prompt about 369AI already written out. Nothing is sent unless you pick one; following a link hands that prompt to the company you picked, under their terms rather than ours.

sharing.title: Who else sees your information
sharing.body: Applications stay with us. We do not pass them to recruitment agencies, advertising networks or data brokers, and we do not sell personal information. We would disclose information only where the law requires it, or to protect our rights and the safety of others. If our business were ever sold or reorganised, we would tell applicants before their information moved.

transfers.title: Where your information goes
transfers.body: We work across India, the UAE, Oman and the United States, so our own staff may read your application from any of those countries. WhatsApp and Google, described above, sit outside them and handle data under their own terms. If you are in the European Economic Area, that means what you send us is dealt with outside it — you can ask us at any point what we hold about you and have it deleted.

security.title: How we protect applications
security.lead: Applications are held on our own server as ordinary files, not in a third-party recruitment service. Access to a CV is deliberately narrow:
security.s1: The download link we send to our hiring team is individually signed and stops working after 30 days.
security.s2: The applications inbox sits behind a passcode session, separate from that link.
security.s3: CVs are never published as static files, and are sent with instructions not to cache or store them.
security.s4: No password of yours is involved, because the site has no visitor accounts to hold one.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep what we need for as long as it serves the reason you gave it, and then we delete it:
retention.r1: Job applications and CVs: kept while they are still of use to us, and deleted by our team when you ask. We do not remove them on a fixed schedule, so if you would like yours gone, write to us and we will delete the application and the CV together.
retention.r2: Enquiries you send over WhatsApp: held in that conversation, and subject to the retention rules of WhatsApp as well as our own.
retention.r3: Storage in your browser: until you clear your browsing data. The staff session cookie expires on its own.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.lead: Wherever you are, you may ask us to do any of the following, and we will not charge you for it:
rights.r1: See a copy of what we hold about you
rights.r2: Correct anything that is wrong or out of date
rights.r3: Delete what we hold — we can remove an application and its CV completely
rights.r4: Withdraw a consent you gave earlier
rights.r5: Object to what we are doing with it, or ask us to restrict it
rights.r6: Receive what you sent us in a portable form
rights.how: Write to us with the details in the last section and tell us what you would like done. We answer within 30 days. If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom you may also complain to your national data protection authority; if you are in India you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

children.title: Children
children.body: This is a business website and it is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16. If you believe a child has sent us something, tell us and we will delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If what we do with your information changes, we will update this page and move the date at the top. Where a change is significant and we hold your contact details, we will tell you directly rather than rely on you noticing.

contact.title: How to contact us
contact.body: For anything in this policy — a question, a correction, or a request to delete what we hold — write to {email} or call {phone}. Our offices are listed on the Contact page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: We could not find the page you were looking for.

integrations.title: Every app you run.
integrations.body: Seven 369ai.Biz apps on one line, the tools they plug into on the other — all of it landing in a single core, with nothing re-typed in between.

builder.title: Client requirements to outputs
builder.body: Whatever logic the client asks for, we convert the idea into a usable solution.
